Title: OMS Linux Agent July 2018 release now available

Body.Content:
The OMS Linux Agent July 2018 release is now available. This release contains many stability and installation improvements, plus introduces support for Ubuntu 18.04. The release also ends support for a few end-of-life Linux versions.

If you have installed the OMS Linux Agent by using Azure Extensions and have automatic extension updates turned on, this update will be automatically applied over the coming weeks. Otherwise, you can use the latest installer available in the agent GitHub repo.

For more information, see the agent release notes.
